events.title: Park City Film Presents: A Dog’s Way Home (Kamas)
events.description: As a puppy, Bella finds her way into the arms of Lucas, a young man who gives her a good home. When Bella becomes separated from Lucas, she soon finds herself on an epic 400-mile journey to reunite with her beloved owner. Along the way, the lost but spirited dog touches the lives of an orphaned mountain lion, a down-on-his-luck veteran and some friendly strangers who happen to cross her path. Base
events.location: Kamas City Park, 505 S Main St, Kamas, UT 84036, USA
